messages.author: 6b6a0612e7e51863
messages.subject: shiny-server.conf   template_dir tag don't work
parts:
Hello,
I'm developing a shiny app recently, I would like to change the login page rather than use the default login.html under /opt/shiny-server/templates;
so I copied the login.html under a new folder /home/chengjie/shinyapp/template, and add the template_dir tag to /etc/shiny-server/shiny-server.conf,
but when I put the "tamplate_dir  /home/chengjie/shinyapp/template;" to .conf file  the shiny-server pro will stop run.(no matter where the tag is in the shiny-server.conf ).

the /etc/shiny-server/shiny-server.conf file like:

///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
run_as shiny;

server{

listen 3939;
ssl /etc/shiny-server/dec.key /etc/shiny-server/dec.cert;

location /{
    site_dir /home/chengjie/shinyapp;

    log_dir /var/log/shin-server;

   directory_index on;

  location /admin {

   template_dir /home/chengjie/shinyapp/template,
   
   required_group adminuser;
 }
}

}

admin 4151 {
   required_user admin;
}

auth_ldap ladp://chengjie.admin.com/dc=amdin, dc=com{
......
}

////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////

Any suggestion ? Thank you so much!

messages.author: 3da48b33a2f506a9
messages.subject: Re: shiny-server.conf   template_dir tag don't work
parts:
To update the forum (this was resolved offline), the cause of this was an older version of Shiny Server that didn't have support for "template_dir". Updating to latest version has fixed the problem.

Fereshteh
